name: Massive damage
author: Alexandria
summary: Taking at least half your hit point maximum in one hit calls for a Constitution save or a nasty effect.

rules.text: When a creature takes damage from one source equal to or greater than **half its hit point maximum**, it makes a **DC 15 Constitution save**. On a failure the GM rolls d10: 1 drop to 0 HP; 2-4 drop to 0 HP but stable; 5-10 stunned until the end of its next turn.

assistant.dm: Massive damage is on: when one hit deals at least half a creature's HP maximum, call for a DC 15 Constitution save. On a fail roll d10: 1 drops to 0 HP, 2-4 drops to 0 HP but stable, 5-10 stunned until the end of its next turn.
assistant.player: At this table a single hit of half your HP maximum or more means a DC 15 Constitution save, or the GM rolls a d10 for a bad result (stunned, or dropped to 0).
